import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
from do_again.service import liveness

config=liveness._settings(repo)
if not config.get("report_stalls"):
    raise SystemExit("stall reporting disabled")

a=liveness._report_stall(repo,config,{},"idle")
b=liveness._report_stall(repo,config,{},"idle")

print(json.dumps({"first":a,"second":b},indent=2,sort_keys=True))

for label,state in [("first",a),("second",b)]:
    if state.get("issue_report")!="existing":
        raise SystemExit(f"{label} report did not dedupe to existing issue: {state}")
    if not state.get("issue_number"):
        raise SystemExit(f"{label} missing issue number")

if a["issue_number"]!=b["issue_number"]:
    raise SystemExit(f"dedupe unstable across fresh states: {a['issue_number']} vs {b['issue_number']}")

if a["issue_number"] not in {19,20}:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected new issue created: {a['issue_number']}")

print("LIVE_STALL_DEDUPE_ACCEPTANCE_OK")
